decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message MODIFY already captures the geometry-first development mode and structural design basis. The source change further defines the role of the separate material treatment and requires no additional Hero V attribute change.
The material treatment's subordinate role does not change the accent's derivation from Hero V geometry or its required consistency with the V system.
The source preserves the long-term material treatment while prioritizing Hero V geometry; it does not change the deferred E and L letterform requirements.
The relationship between material and resolved geometry does not alter the deferred full-wordmark kerning goal.
The source does not change the second V's derivation rule or shared geometric and material characteristics; it only constrains when and how the separate material treatment should influence design.
The source decision about material treatment does not change the second V's subordinate visual prominence relative to the Hero V.
